name: Corn grain feed; dry processing; region 3, at farm
description: Data for the material and energy requirements and for the growing, harvesting, drying, and transporting of 1 pound of corn grain in Region 3. Production practices and inputs are an aggregation of state-level data from 2005 to 2009. Includes emissions associated with application of fertilizers (nitrogen, phosphorous, potassium and lime).
category: 11: Agriculture, Forestry, Fishing and Hunting/1111: Oilseed and Grain Farming

processDocumentation.timeDescription: Producer survey and literature data (NASS, Budgets, USLCI, EPA) covering years 2005-2009
processDocumentation.geographyDescription: The unit process is assumed to represent the regional production of corn in Region 3 (US).  US Region 3 includes Minnesota, Wisconsin, Michigan, Ohio, Indiana, Illinois, Missouri, and Iowa.
processDocumentation.technologyDescription: Average cradle-to-farm gate corn production in the specified region.  Includes average irrigation water use (unspecified origin), and arable land use based on corn yield. Includes energy (electricity and LPG) farm use, diesel and gasoline for on farm equipment, corn drying (water evaporated to dry corn by 5 moisture percentage points for storage (85% by high temperature)). Includes production and transport of fertilizers (nitrogen, phosphate, potash, lime, boron, sulfur, manure) as well as the field emissions to air (dinitrogen monoxide and ammonia), water emissions of nitrate and phosphorus.
processDocumentation.inventoryMethodDescription: Life cycle inventory was originally assembled using the SimaPro software platform (Version 8.0.4.26) and was modified for submission using the OpenLCA platform (Version 1.3.0).
processDocumentation.completenessDescription: The models include resource use and the main environmental impact drivers of corn production. Land transformation was not estimated. Planting, fertilizing and harvesting equipment was aggregated and shown in our model as fuel conumption.  Emissions of heavy metals to soil was not included.  Emissions associated with the production and application of pesticides were not included. Phosporous emissions to water was not classified to specific subcompartment such as groundwater or river. Water source (groundwater, etc.) for irrigation was not specified. We assumed 100 km transport of materials (fertilizers, pesticides etc.) to farm. Solid waste and waste water treatment was not included. State level data for production acreage, yield, fertilizer and pesticide inputs were aggregated to regions.
processDocumentation.dataSelectionDescription: Producer survey and literature data (NASS, Budgets, USLCI, EPA). Crop production 2007 summary. See NASS (2007).
processDocumentation.dataTreatmentDescription: Aggregation method was used in which  state level data was aggregated to model particular region and divided by total corn production in that region (for example, sum of fertilizer state level data was divided by total corn production in that region). One exeption is nitrogen from manure where nitrogen requirements to meet reported yield was used to caculate the amount of manure applied to corn.
processDocumentation.dataCollectionDescription: Data was collected during an ongoing project in 2010
